svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.13.5 Wired Glass as a Closure
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.13.5 Wired Glass as a Closure
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Wired Glass as a Closure

g.text: Wired glass, at least 6 mm (¼″), in a vertical
fire separation rated not more than 1 h
Each pane: not over 0.8 m² (8.6 ft²), and not
over 1.4 m (4′-7⅛″) high or wide; glass not
held by mullions: not over 7.5 m² (81 ft²)
Fixed steel frame, metal at least 1.35 mm
(13/16″) on each side of the glass

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Wired glass conforming to Article 9.6.1.2.
that has not been tested in accordance with
Article 9.10.3.1. is permitted as a closure in
a vertical fire separation required to have a
rating of not more than 1 h
Provided the glass is not less than 6 mm (¼″)
thick and is mounted in conformance with Sentence
The glass is mounted in fixed steel frames
with a metal thickness of not less than 1.35
mm (0.053″) and a glazing stop of not less
than 20 mm (13/16″) on each side of the glass
Individual panes do not exceed 0.8 m² (8.6
ft²) in area or 1.4 m (4′-7⅛″) in height or
width, and the area of glass not structurally
supported by mullions does not exceed 7.5 m²
(81 ft²)
Drawn: a glazed panel in a rated wall, and a close-up of the frame cut through. Pane sizes are an example, wire mesh shown as lines.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.13.5. (page 9-78)
